about: The edc: URI scheme (mappingLayers ML1-a, ruled by BRONZE_CROWN 2026-10-24). Kinds are DATA: edcUri.js mints and parses only the kinds listed here, and an unlisted kind is refused by name. A template is '/'-separated segments after baseIri; a segment is literal text and {placeholders}. Every placeholder value is encoded by segmentEncoding unless the kind lists it under verbatimPartList (a part copied from an already-minted URI, whose spelling another module owns). A published URI is never respelled; a scheme change is a new prefix segment (D-URI). Nothing here is published yet (w3id ruled NO public registration; a local stub resolves).

segmentEncoding.about: UTF-8 after NFC; each byte whose ASCII character is in literalCharacterList is kept, every other byte becomes %XX with uppercase hex. '/', '@', '%', space and ',' are therefore always encoded inside a value.

vocabularyIriByCurie.about: objects that are vocabulary terms, not graph nodes: an abstention row's object (SSSOM 1.0: sssom:NoTermFound MAY stand as object_id)

kindList.about: a HubReference card (exists; minted by the hub framework as namespace + release segment + '/' + addressSignature)
a standard's slot; standardName is the _source name the graph stamps on every node and edge
a mapping layer, floating: resolves to its current Standard version
a layer version by its tag (an alias the registry records; never reassigned)
a layer version by its content id
one mapping assertion, scoped by the decision block that holds it (R-1)
element x layer, follows the layer
a published manifest by its label (an alias)
a manifest by its membership hash
manifest x element, answered by the manifest's default layer for every hub
a person, by educore user refId, never the username (D-AUTHOR)
a machine author, by its judge identity
(ML3-b) the whole site's SSSOM mapping registry: it imports every layer's registry (each layer's registry id is its floating layer URI, layer/{layerKey})

(ML3-a) a mapping predicate EDUcore declares, spelled as the r1 rater sets already expand it (edc:bestMatch = https://w3id.org/EDUcore/bestMatch; registered, so never respelled). CLOSED: only a term listed here and defined in vocabularyTermDefinitionByName is minted or parsed. D-RATERPRED.

vocabularyTermDefinitionByName.about: (ML3-a) what each vocabularyTerm means; the stub resolver returns this text. Raters were never asked a SKOS relation, so neither term claims one; agreement is measured on the object (D-RATERPRED).
vocabularyTermDefinitionByName.bestMatch: The author chose this meaning (HubReference card) as the best answer for the subject element among the cards offered. No SKOS relation (exact, close, broad, narrow) is asserted.
vocabularyTermDefinitionByName.alsoAcceptable: The author marked this meaning as also acceptable (the rater tool's Same) for the subject element, beside a best answer. No SKOS relation is asserted.
